items.title: "The tool: Uridine monophosphate (UMP). There's no study showing ..."
items.where: Dopamine Receptor Burnout / DAWS Pattern: Uridine Monophosphate, P2
items.my_version: The tool: Uridine monophosphate (UMP). There's no study showing that "UMP cures DAWS", only more basic research on what uridine, choline, and DHA do in the brain. All three get carried in the blood to the brain, which uses them to make the fatty membranes at its synapses (circulating precursors for brain phosphatide / synaptic membrane synthesis). Wurtman's research group found that [giving the three together can increase synaptic membrane components and synaptic proteins](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4011061/), and that in animals, adding UMP to DHA made the neurons grow more new connection points ([DHA-induced dendritic spine formation](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2140951/)). And [old rats that got UMP in their food released more dopamine when their neurons were stimulated with potassium, and grew more nerve fibers](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16055952/). So it's plausible that it works on the synapses this way, but using it for DAWS in people means carefully extrapolating from those studies and from anecdotes like Scott's.
items.before: The tool:Uridine monophosphate (UMP). The best evidence is not "UMP cures DAWS"; that study does not exist. The evidence is more basic: uridine, choline, and DHA are circulating precursors for brain phosphatide / synaptic membrane synthesis. Wurtman's group has shown that DHA + uridine + choline can increase synaptic membrane components and synaptic proteins, that DHA-induced dendritic spine formation is enhanced by UMP in animals, and that dietary UMP increased potassium-evoked dopamine release and neurite outgrowth in aged rats. So the mechanism is plausible, but the DAWS use is still a cautious human extrapolation plus anecdote.

items.title: "Scott's signal: Scott already had choline from eggs ..."
items.where: Dopamine Receptor Burnout / DAWS Pattern: Uridine Monophosphate, P3
items.my_version: Scott added a standard dose of UMP, and within a day his ketamine/LSD cravings fell hard. He already had choline covered with eggs, and took fish oil for DHA/EPA. His psychedelic tolerance seemed to drop too. You can't tell from this whether UMP rebuilt his D3 receptors overnight. It does suggest that in the right person, UMP can show you very clearly when the brain's system for rebuilding synaptic membranes and recovering dopamine receptors has been starved of building materials. Scott was having vivid dreams again too, with real childhood memories coming back in them.
items.before: Scott's signal: Scott already had choline from eggs and DHA/EPA from fish oil. After adding standard-dose UMP, he got a striking response within a day: vivid dreams returned, real childhood memories came back in dreams, psychedelic tolerance seemed to drop, and ketamine/LSD craving fell hard. That does not prove UMP rebuilt D3 receptors overnight. It does suggest that, in the right person, UMP can be a very clean signal that the synaptic-membrane / dopamine-receptor-recovery axis was starved.

items.title: "Precautions/Side Effects: Do not use concurrently with opioids and/or kratom ..."
items.where: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, P9
items.my_version: Precautions/Side Effects: Do not use concurrently with opioids and/or kratom (will reduce tolerance), clonidine and/or guanfacine, blood pressure lowering medications (including nitrates and PDE-5 inhibitors), or other complex "psych" stacks without having a physician competent to consider the likelihoods of problematic interactions. Not recommended for use in pregnancy or breast-feeding. Use with extreme caution in those with a prior psychotic episode, lower end blood pressure, or kidney or liver issues.

Not recommended for use in pregnancy or breast-feeding. Use with extreme caution in those with bipolar disorder, prior psychotic episode, unstable panic disorder, lower end blood pressure, kidney or liver issues, or those with a currently-high likelihood of relapsing in addictions.

items.title: "Stop immediately if it causes flatness, anhedonia, emotional blunting ..."
items.where: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, P10
items.my_version: Stop immediately if it causes flatness, anhedonia, emotional blunting, new depression, agitation, insomnia, dizziness, palpitations, nausea, loose stools, diarrhea, or increased craving. Only the stomach problems showed up in the human trials, but the flatness happens in practice, so do not "push through" numbness. If agmatine makes the world more gray, it is the wrong tool for that phase.

items.title: "Agmatine Sulfate (Optional Trial): Start with 250–500 mg ..."
items.my_version: Agmatine Sulfate (Optional Trial): Start with 250–500 mg in the morning or early afternoon for 3 days. If it clearly reduces the hot/itchy/reactive state without flattening mood, use 500 mg once or twice daily. For this protocol, cap at 1 g/day.

items.title: "Rule: do not take 5-HTP on the same day as psychedelics ..."
items.where: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, P12
items.my_version: Rule: do not take 5-HTP on the same day as psychedelics, and do not use it anywhere near ayahuasca/harmalas or iboga unless the whole medicine plan has been medically reviewed. Uridine is not serotonergic, but it may still change dream vividness, visual sensitivity, craving, and psychedelic tolerance; that's from experience, like Scott's below, not from studies. Do not take UMP on the same day as psychedelics; if sensitivity changes, assume your old psychedelic dose may now be too high.

items.title: "Side effects / stop signs: The most common problem is the "choline headache" ..."
items.where: Dopamine Receptor Burnout / DAWS Pattern: Uridine Monophosphate, P5
items.my_version: Side effects / stop signs: In practice, the most common problem is the "choline headache" or spaced-out brain fog. It isn't in the studies, but the likely reason is that if UMP accelerates membrane synthesis while choline availability is low, the system can feel under-supplied. Other stop signs include insomnia, jitteriness, racing thoughts, irritability, emotional flatness, nausea, stomach cramps, or loose stools. If it makes you wired, numb, or weirdly irritable, stop. Do not push through.

items.title: "Dose: 300–600 mg/day, taken earlier in the day ..."
items.my_version:
Dose: about 400 mg/day, taken earlier in the day. In the stress studies, which used a PS complex, 400 mg blunted the cortisol response, while 200 mg did nothing and 600 or 800 mg didn't either.

Phosphatidylserine about 400 mg earlier in the day only if you fit the high-cortisol profile + 1 cup broccoli sprouts + Magnesium Glycinate 400 mg + NAC 1.8–2.4 g divided.

items.title: "Warning: Direct D-Serine carries a higher renal (kidney) load than L-Serine ..."
items.my_version: Warning: High doses of D-Serine damaged the kidneys in rat studies, so it carries a kidney caution, though kidney problems have been rare in human studies. Do not exceed 30mg/kg and ensure high water intake.
items.before: Warning: Direct D-Serine carries a higher renal (kidney) load than L-Serine. Do not exceed 30mg/kg and ensure high water intake. This risk is compounded by the higher renal load caused by a keto diet or high protein intake.
